{"metadata":{"description":"Current project and its git state at a glance for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: the project name with its branch and change counts, at the top-right corner of the Work window's conversation header","id":"gh:1335967047","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"omdsh-status","slug":"omdsh-plugins/omdsh-status","topics":["dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Current project and its git state at a glance for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: the project name wit"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"h its branch and change counts, at the top-right corner of the Work window's conversation header"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# omdsh-status"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Which project, which branch, how much has moved — at a glance. This plugin
puts the current conversa"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"tion's project name and its git state in the
conversation header of the
DeepSeek Harness web GUI's
W"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ork window, just left of the Session log export button:"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The project name is the title of the workspace the conversation lives in (the
group heading you alre"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ady read in the sidebar). Beside it: the checked-out
branch, and whichever of ahead/behind, staged, "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"modified, untracked, and
conflicts are non-zero. A clean tree shows the branch alone; conflicts are "},{"id":"p6s4","text":"the
one count drawn in the alarm colour, because a row where every glyph shouts
says nothing. The to"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"oltip carries the full directory, every count in words,
and why the figures are stale when a refresh"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"rries the full directory, every count in words,
and why the figures are stale when a refresh failed."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"A conversation that has not started yet has no header at all — the harness
hides it — so the same re"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"adout holds that row's own corner from the frame's
floating layer, on the same pixels, and hands the"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"m back the moment the header
returns:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## What it adds"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Surface | Where it comes from |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| The readout left of the Session log button in the conversation header | `conversation.session.head"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"er.utilities`, ui-conversation's trailing row — `order: -1` keeps it left of the harness's default-o"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"rder utilities |
| The same readout holding that row's corner on a new session | `shell.overlay`, ui"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"-layout's frame-wide floating layer — the stand-in, for the conversations whose header the harness i"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"s not drawing |
| `GET /omdsh-status/status` | `webServer`, behind the same browser-trust fence as t"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"GET /omdsh-status/status` | `webServer`, behind the same browser-trust fence as the `/api` gateway |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"There is no settings namespace. Nothing here needs a person's decision — the
project name is the wor"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"kspace's own title, the git counts are the working
directory's own state, and the poll cadence is fi"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ce's own title, the git counts are the working
directory's own state, and the poll cadence is fixed."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## How the readout is assembled"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Each half reads from whoever already knows:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **The browser derives the project name.** The page already holds the live
workspace and session li"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"sts: find the workspace accounting for the current
session, and its title is the project. Nothing is"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" guessed or stored — the
lists move, the readout follows.
- **The host runs git.** A browser cannot "},{"id":"p15s4","text":"read `.git`, so the host half
resolves the session's working directory and runs
`git --no-optional-l"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"ocks -C <dir> status --porcelain=v1 --branch`, then
answers with the parsed counts as JSON. **No pat"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"h list, no diff, no branch
graph** ever reaches the browser — only the handful of numbers it draws —"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"
and the route sits behind the same trust check as `/api`.
- **A new session gets the same answer, i"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"n the same place.** The harness hides
the whole session header while a conversation is still blank —"},{"id":"p15s9","text":" which is
exactly when the branch is worth knowing, since you are about to say what to
do in this pr"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"oject. So a second entry stands in for that row from the frame's
floating layer: the column's top-ri"},{"id":"p15s11","text":"ght corner, inset by the header's own
measured padding, at the same row height, so the readout does "},{"id":"p15s12","text":"not move when
the header comes and goes. It stands down the moment the header entry
announces itself"},{"id":"p15s13","text":", so the two never show at once — and that is read off the
header entry's own mount rather than off "},{"id":"p15s14","text":""is the conversation blank", which
is ui-conversation's rule to change, not this plugin's to copy.
-"},{"id":"p15s15","text":" **That corner is shared, and packed without a registry.**
`omdsh-sidepanel`'s switches hold its out"},{"id":"p15s16","text":"er end and `omdsh-sidechat`'s summon
icon tucks in beside them; this readout is the utility row's le"},{"id":"p15s17","text":"ftmost entry,
so its stand-in measures the occupant that has already tucked itself furthest
IN and g"},{"id":"p15s18","text":"oes inboard of that. The neighbour measures the opposite end, so the
dependency runs one way and the"},{"id":"p15s19","text":" row settles in a single pass. Only boxes are
read — never another plugin's code, state, or identity"},{"id":"p15s20","text":" — and an empty corner
is measured as empty: the readout takes the header's own padding.
- **A chat "},{"id":"p15s21","text":"is not a project.** When a mode system is composed
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## When pieces are missing"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **The directory is not in a repository, git is not installed, or the command
times out.** The read"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"out shows the project name alone and the tooltip says
"not a git repository". None of these are erro"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"rs — "no git here" is the
honest answer.
- **No conversation is selected, or it belongs to no worksp"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"ace.** Both entries
render nothing; there is no project to name yet.
- **Chat mode.** The readout re"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"nders nothing and the poll stops: a chat names
no project. Switch to Work and both return.
- **No mo"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"de system is composed.** Nothing is a chat, so nothing hides — the
readout behaves exactly as it did"},{"id":"p17s7","text":" before the rule existed. `sessionModes` is
read on a restricted fiber and never injected, so its ab"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"sence costs this
behaviour and nothing else.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- **Both seats are borrowed.** The readout lives on the conversation header's
trailing row and, whil"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"e that row is away, on the pixels it would occupy. Code
mode replaces the whole column with a termin"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"al and takes both with it; there
the readout is simply not drawn, which degrades to nothing rather t"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"han to
something wrong.
- **The stand-in lands where the row's live occupants are, not where the
hea"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"der's would be.** The Session log export button sits between this readout
and its neighbours in the "},{"id":"p19s6","text":"drawn header, and that button has no stand-in of
its own — it has nothing to export yet. So on a new"},{"id":"p19s7","text":" session the readout sits
the width of that button further right than it will once the header return"},{"id":"p19s8","text":"s.
Reserving space for a control nobody is drawing would be a guess; holding the
row's height and co"},{"id":"p19s9","text":"rner is a measurement.
- **The counts are a poll, not a stream.** A change shows up on the next poll"},{"id":"p19s10","text":",
so the badge can be up to a few seconds behind the index, and a poll that
fails keeps the previous"},{"id":"p19s11","text":" figures dimmed until one succeeds.
- **"No git" is one wide net.** Git not installed, a repository "},{"id":"p19s12","text":"it refuses to
touch (dubious ownership), or a `git status` that outlives its timeout all
read as "no"},{"id":"p19s13","text":"t a git repository" — the tooltip does not distinguish them."}],"truncated":true}
